For layer 1 (\(n_1=2.32\), thickness \(15\,\text{mm}\)), \(\theta_1 = \arcsin(\sin52^\circ/2.32) \approx 19.864^\circ\). For layer 2 (\(n_2=1.45\), thickness \(14\,\text{mm}\)), \(\theta_2 = \arcsin(\sin52^\circ/1.45) \approx 32.93^\circ\). The total lateral displacement \(d\) is the perpendicular distance between the incident ray (extended straight through the stack) and the emergent ray. It can be computed as
\[
d = \sum_{i=1}^2 t_i \sin\theta_0 \left(1 - \frac{\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{n_i^2 - \sin^2\theta_0}}\right),
